macros.name: ifmrcinmap
macros.doc: If the given ⟨latitude⟩ and ⟨longitude⟩ describes a point inside the visible map, the ⟨true⟩ code is executed, otherwise the ⟨false⟩ code.

macros.name: ifmrcinvicinity
macros.doc: If the given ⟨latitude⟩ and ⟨longitude⟩ describes a point inside a vicinity of the visible map, i.e. the map plus a margin of mermap/vicinity, the ⟨true⟩ code is executed, otherwise the ⟨false⟩ code.

macros.name: ifmrcNPexists
macros.doc: If the given named position with given ⟨name⟩ exists, the ⟨true⟩ code is executed, otherwise the ⟨false⟩ code.

macros.name: ifmrcNPinmap
macros.doc: If the given named position (NP) ⟨name⟩ describes a point inside the visible map, the ⟨true⟩ code is executed, otherwise the ⟨false⟩ code.

macros.name: ifmrcNPinvicinity
macros.doc: If the given named position (NP) ⟨name⟩ describes a point inside a vicinity of the visible map, the ⟨true⟩ code is executed, otherwise the ⟨false⟩ code, see \ifmrcinvicinity.

macros.name: mermapset
macros.doc: Sets ⟨options⟩ for all following maps inside the current TeX group.

macros.name: mermapsetmarker
macros.doc: Sets ⟨options⟩ for all following markers inside the current TeX group.

macros.name: mermapsetsupply
macros.doc: Sets ⟨options⟩ for all following maps inside the current TeX group.

macros.name: mrcactivatescript
macros.doc: Use this inside the preamble of your document to activate the accompanying Python script.

macros.name: mrcAnimAngle
macros.doc: Current angle between the tangent vector to the orthodrome and the current parallel circle.

macros.name: mrcAnimLatitude
macros.doc: The latitude of the current position.

macros.name: mrcAnimLongitude
macros.doc: The longitude of the current position.

macros.name: mrcAnimTime
macros.doc: The current time ranging from 0 to 1.

macros.name: mrcboundmap
macros.doc: Sets the picture bounding box according to the applied map.

macros.name: mrcclipmap
macros.doc: Clips all subsequent drawings against the applied map.

macros.name: mrcdefinemap
macros.doc: Establishes a map inside a tikzpicture environment following and applying the given ⟨options⟩.

macros.name: mrcdrawinfo
macros.doc: Draws some map information overlay for debugging purposes only.

macros.name: mrcdrawnetwork
macros.doc: Draws a geodetic network with meridians and parallels.

macros.name: mrcdraworthodrome
macros.doc: Draws an orthodrome curve from a point with latitude ⟨lat1⟩ and longitude ⟨lon1⟩ to a point with latitude ⟨lat2⟩ and longitude ⟨lon2⟩.

macros.name: mrcdrawscalebar
macros.doc: Draws a scale bar according to the given ⟨options⟩.

macros.name: mrcformlat
macros.doc: Formatted output for a given ⟨latitude⟩ following given ⟨options⟩.

macros.name: mrcformlon
macros.doc: Formatted output for a given ⟨longitude⟩ following given ⟨options⟩.

macros.name: mrcmapscaledenominator
macros.doc: Approximate map scale denominator.

macros.name: mrcmarker
macros.doc: Places a marker according to the given ⟨options⟩ on the map.

macros.name: mrcnewmarkerstyle
macros.doc: Creates a new mermap/marker/style value ⟨style name⟩ using the given ⟨options⟩ for drawing a place marker.

macros.name: mrcNPdef
macros.doc: A coordinate pair of ⟨latitude⟩ and ⟨longitude⟩ can be saved as named position (NP) to a ⟨name⟩ for later use.

macros.name: mrcNPfromOrthoDistance
macros.doc: Defines a new named position ⟨name⟩ which is located on a ⟨distance⟩ from the starting point of the orthodromic curve from a point with latitude ⟨lat1⟩ and longitude ⟨lon1⟩ (or described by a named position ⟨name1⟩) to a point with latitude ⟨lat2⟩ and longitude ⟨lon2⟩ (or described by a named position ⟨name2⟩).

macros.name: mrcNPfromOrthoFraction
macros.doc: Defines a new named position ⟨name⟩ which is located on a ⟨fraction⟩ from the starting point of the orthodromic curve from a point with latitude ⟨lat1⟩ and longitude ⟨lon1⟩ (or described by a named position ⟨name1⟩) to a point with latitude ⟨lat2⟩ and longitude ⟨lon2⟩ (or described by a named position ⟨name2⟩).

macros.name: mrcNPfrompoint
macros.doc: Latitude and longitude of a given ⟨TikZ point⟩ are calculated and saved as named position (NP) with given ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: mrcNPlat
macros.doc: Inserts the latitude of a named position with given ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: mrcNPlon
macros.doc: Inserts the longitude of a named position with given ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: mrcNPprettyloxodistance
macros.doc: Approximate loxodromic distance between two named positions ⟨name1⟩ and ⟨name2⟩ with three valid digits.

macros.name: mrcNPprettyorthodistance
macros.doc: Approximate orthodromic distance between two named positions ⟨name1⟩ and ⟨name2⟩ with three valid digits.

macros.name: mrcpgfpoint
macros.doc: Yields a low level pgf point location given by ⟨latitude⟩ and ⟨longitude⟩.

macros.name: mrcprettyloxodistance
macros.doc: Approximate loxodromic distance between two points with latitude ⟨lat1⟩, longitude ⟨lon1⟩ and latitude ⟨lat2⟩, longitude ⟨lon2⟩ with three valid digits.

macros.name: mrcprettymapscale
macros.doc: Approximate map scale given with three valid digits with a representation like 1:1000.

macros.name: mrcprettyorthodistance
macros.doc: Approximate orthodromic distance between two points with latitude ⟨lat1⟩, longitude ⟨lon1⟩ and latitude ⟨lat2⟩, longitude ⟨lon2⟩ with three valid digits.

macros.name: mrcscale
macros.doc: Scaling factor between map and real world.

macros.name: mrcsetapikey
macros.doc: Stores an API key ⟨value⟩ for access with the given ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: mrcstoreloxodistance
macros.doc: Stores the approximate loxodromic distance (in kilometers) between two points with latitude ⟨lat1⟩, longitude ⟨lon1⟩ and latitude ⟨lat2⟩, longitude ⟨lon2⟩ to a given ⟨macro⟩.

macros.name: mrcstoreorthodistance
macros.doc: Stores the approximate orthodromic distance (in kilometers) between two points with latitude ⟨lat1⟩, longitude ⟨lon1⟩ and latitude ⟨lat2⟩, longitude ⟨lon2⟩ to a given ⟨macro⟩.

macros.name: mrcsupplymap
macros.doc: The ⟨options⟩ provide parameters for the Python 3 script to supply all materials for a map.

macros.name: mrctextokm
macros.doc: Computes a given TeX ⟨length⟩ (with unit) into the corresponding real world length in kilometers (without unit).

macros.name: mrctextomile
macros.doc: Computes a given TeX ⟨length⟩ (with unit) into the corresponding real world length in miles (without unit).

macros.name: mrctexwidth
macros.doc: TeX length denoting the document width of the current map.

macros.name: mrcTimewarpIdentity
macros.doc: Identity function from [0, 1] into [0, 1].

macros.name: mrcTimewarpSlowStart
macros.doc: If ⟨exponent⟩ > 1 is used, time flows slower at the begin of the interval [0, 1].

envs.name: mrcAnimation
envs.doc: According to the given ⟨options⟩, the environment loops over the ⟨environment content⟩ several times generating frames for an external animation program.

envs.name: mrcroute
envs.doc: This environment creates a TikZ path with given TikZ ⟨options⟩.
